archetype_reasoning: A clean, functional, minimalist interface focused on management/dashboard capabilities, elevated by the striking, custom red palette provided by the user. Generous whitespace and 'Montserrat' typography ensure clarity and modern feel.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Bento grid for dashboard, Control Room grid for lists/schedules. Clean separation via whitespace rather than heavy borders.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 bg-[#ffffff] border-r border-[#e28b95]/30 flex flex-col justify-between hidden md:flex
spacing_and_layout.header: h-16 bg-[#ffffff] border-b border-[#e28b95]/30 flex items-center justify-between px-6 md:px-8

buttons.primary: bg-[#c72137] text-white hover:bg-[#cf3f57] font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#f7e1e1] text-[#c72137] hover:bg-[#ecb7bb] font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-[#e28b95] text-[#c72137] hover:bg-[#fcf7f6] font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors

cards.base: bg-[#ffffff] rounded-xl border border-[#e28b95]/20 shadow-sm overflow-hidden

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

inputs.base: block w-full rounded-md border border-[#e28b95]/40 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder-gray-400 focus:border-[#c72137] focus:ring-[#c72137]/20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-shadow

tables.header: bg-[#fcf7f6] text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider

brand_logo.description: Red Music / Logomarca Babecue provided by user. Use in Sidebar top and Header left.

avatar_1.description: Male singer portrait for volunteer management list

avatar_2.description: Female singer portrait outdoors for volunteer list

avatar_3.description: Young male singer in studio for volunteer management list

worship_band_bg.description: Worship band performing on stage. Can be used for login screen or empty states.

modules_instructions.dashboard: Focus on metrics cards (Volunteers, Schedules, Burnout alerts). Use generous spacing. Cards should use the #fcf7f6 background for highlights or white with #e28b95/20 borders.
modules_instructions.volunteers: List/Grid view of volunteers with avatars, tags for instruments/phases, and status badges (#f7e1e1 for active/brand).
modules_instructions.schedules: Calendar or list view. Emphasize confirmation status.
modules_instructions.song_bank: List of songs with tags for key, BPM. Clean tabular data.
modules_instructions.setlists: Drag and drop or ordered list UI with filters.
modules_instructions.general: The system should have a sidebar menu with the logo and links to modules. Utilize Montserrat for all typography and apply the precise colors requested.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='volunteer-add-button'`, `data-testid='dashboard-metrics-card'`).
